fail.name: fantasy-farmstead
fail.problems: The thatched farmhouse and shed sit on a closed horizontal tan yard strip at approximately x=6..40, y=29..33. Both ends stop within the crops; no lane reaches any of the four tile edges. This is visible in isolation and repeats as a disconnected floating yard in every shuffle. Extend a narrow readable lane from the yard to one edge, crossing the boundary at a right angle through a small hedge opening; keep the surrounding two large fields running to the edge. Carry the exact lane/yard geometry through all four seasons. The new edge-to-edge fields, farmhouse size and roof-plus-south-face view are acceptable.
